|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Roche (V)]]; it is the current text. The first image is the release-sheet slip (Light Side half, which prints it); the second is a CardMaker recreation of the whole card with this text ([[:File:VB7-07-Roche-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Players Committee card image prints the original text (see [[Roche (V)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Roche (V)]]): released as a Virtual Block 7 preview card in the Players Committee news post “Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes” (23 July 2010, effective 26 July 2010), Light Side text<ref name="src-S4">Players Committee news post "Pre-Worlds 2010 errata changes", 23 July 2010 (effective 26 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100820023348/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=255:pre-worlds-2010-errata-changes&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Unless opponent controls this system, Commence Primary Ignition may not target it.” The Dark Side text is the unchanged Decipher text (“Force drain -1 here. If you control, Asteroid Sanctuary at related sector is canceled.”). The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-L-roche-pre.gif]]) prints both.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet (official text as of 15 December 2010) names the system: “may not target Roche” instead of “may not target it”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf#page=4 Virtual Block 7.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 15 December 2010"), page 4, slip 28 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016180935/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_2.pdf#page=4 Internet Archive]</ref>; the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 44) prints the same<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=44, page 44. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=44 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Unless opponent controls this system, Commence Primary Ignition may not target Roche.” The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-07-Roche.png]], Light Side half only) and the Master List slip print it; the Dark Side text did not change.
